policy.scope: Customer-safe triage only. The AI may guide basic external checks but must not provide repair instructions.
policy.safety_override: Any safety flag immediately exits the tree and escalates.

nodes.question: Is the thermostat set to cooling and below the current room temperature?

nodes.guidance: If it is safe and simple, set the thermostat to cooling and a few degrees below room temperature. If it still does not cool, I can schedule service.

nodes.question: Is air coming from the vents?
Is the air filter very dirty or blocked?
Does the outdoor unit appear to be running?

nodes.guidance: If the breaker is safely accessible and tripped, you may reset it once. If it trips again, do not reset it repeatedly. I can schedule a technician.

nodes.question: Do you see ice on the unit or water around the system?
Before we troubleshoot, do you smell gas, see smoke, or have a carbon monoxide alarm going off?
Is the thermostat set to heat and above the current room temperature?

nodes.guidance: If it is safe and simple, set the thermostat to heat and a few degrees above room temperature. If heat does not start, I can schedule service.

nodes.question: Is air blowing from the vents?
Is the air cool or lukewarm instead of warm?
Is water actively leaking and causing property damage?
Is the water near the indoor unit, drain line, ceiling, or outdoor unit?

nodes.guidance: If water is threatening floors or ceilings, protect the area if safe. Avoid opening equipment panels. I can schedule service.

nodes.question: Does your thermostat use replaceable batteries?

nodes.guidance: If you are comfortable, you can replace the batteries. If the display stays blank, I can schedule service.

nodes.question: Is it set to the correct mode: heat, cool, or auto?

nodes.guidance: You can adjust the mode and setpoint. If the system still does not respond, I can schedule service.

nodes.question: Does the HVAC system respond when you change the setpoint?
